preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 750
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 750) representing the number of ribbons.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip()) > 0 and all(c in {'a', 'b'} for c in line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines contains a non-empty greeting string composed exclusively of characters 'a' and 'b'.
The total length of all greetings does not exceed 10,000,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is an integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ n) representing the maximum size of a stylish set.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: The second line of stdout contains space-separated integers representing the 1-based indices of the ribbons in the stylish set.
The number of indices in the second line equals k (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: all(not any(greetings[i-1] in greetings[j-1] for j in selected_indices if i != j) for i in selected_indices)
postconditions.description: For every pair of ribbons in the selected set, no greeting is a substring of another. Here, greetings is the list of all input greetings (1-based), and selected_indices is the set of 1-based indices from the second line of stdout.

postconditions.expression: not exists(k_max, selected_indices) such that (k_max > int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[0]) or (k_max == int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[0]) and len(set(selected_indices)) > len(set(stdout.strip().splitlines()[1].split())))) and all(not any(greetings[i-1] in greetings[j-1] for j in selected_indices if i != j) for i in selected_indices)
postconditions.description: The selected set is of maximum possible size k, and no larger stylish set exists. Here, greetings is the list of all input greetings (1-based), and selected_indices is the set of 1-based indices from the second line of stdout.
